background.$description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Background color for a contrasted surface (a high-contrast chip that inverts against the ambient theme, e.g. tooltips)

text.$description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Text color for a contrasted surface, legible against the contrasted background. This channel is unique to `contrasted` (and any future polarity-inverting surface): a depth surface (layer1/2/3) keeps the ambient page polarity, so its text stays `--color-text` and it deliberately emits no `--surface-color-text`. Consume as `var(--surface-color-text, var(--color-text))` — the fallback is the surface family's consistency mechanism: polarity-inverting surfaces override, same-polarity surfaces fall through.

checkmark.$description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Fill color for the indicator dot inside radio button components placed on a contrasted surface

$description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Surface: contrasted context. A fully-provisioned high-contrast surface that inverts against the ambient theme via light-dark() (dark chip on light UI, light chip on dark UI). All 15 rest roles are bound to contrasted base tokens (background/text plus every foreground channel: ghost, input, navigation, checkbox, radio, switch). States derived at runtime.
